parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a retractable pen, typically made of durable plastic and located at the top of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, engaging an internal spring mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and released, controlling the internal ink cartridge position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the pen, made of plastic, providing structure and housing the ink cartridge.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the grip area for writing and holds the internal components such as the ink refill and spring.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a stable surface for gripping and writing.
